title: Crestline Summit Club Cancellation and Refund Rules
content:
Only the member can cancel a Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships lounge membership. A membership cancelled within the membership's full-refund window of calendar days after its start date, with no club visit recorded on it, is refunded in full. After that window, or once a visit has been made, dues are refunded only when the membership provides for a prorated refund, and then for the unused full calendar months of the membership year. Guest fees and extra-visit fees are never refunded once the entry took place, and dues paid with miles are refunded as miles to the Summit membership rather than as cash. Each charge can be refunded at most once. A Summit Club Lifetime membership is refundable only inside the cancellation window, and a membership granted as a choice benefit is cancelled without any refund.

The full-refund window and whether a prorated refund applies are set per membership. The member's lounge charges stand at the dues, lifetime price, guest fees and extra-visit fees charged, less the refunds made.

## Decision table

| Membership and cancellation | Club visit recorded? | Refund of the dues or price |
|---|---|---|
| Cancelled within the full-refund window after the start date | No | In full |
| Cancelled within the window | Yes | Only where the membership provides a prorated refund: the unused full calendar months of the membership year |
| Cancelled after the window | Either | Only where the membership provides a prorated refund: the unused full calendar months of the membership year |
| Summit Club Lifetime, cancelled after the window | Either | None — refundable only inside the cancellation window |
| Granted as a choice benefit | Either | None |

| Charge | Refund treatment |
|---|---|
| Guest fee or extra-visit fee whose entry took place | Never refunded |
| Dues paid with Summit miles | Refunded as miles to the member's Summit membership, not as cash |
| Any charge already refunded once | Not refunded again — the records show a refund reversing that charge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

**Inside the window.** A membership with a hypothetical full-refund window of 30 calendar days starts on 1 March and is cancelled on 10 March. If no club visit is recorded on it, the dues are refunded in full. If a visit was recorded on 5 March, the full refund does not apply; the dues are refunded only on a membership that provides a prorated refund, for the unused full calendar months.

**Prorated.** A membership that provides a prorated refund, with hypothetical dues of 1200 USD for a membership year of 12 calendar months beginning 1 January, is cancelled on 20 April, after the window. April is partly used; May through December are 8 unused full calendar months. The refund is 1200 USD divided by 12 months, multiplied by 8 months: 800 USD.

**Miles.** Where the dues being refunded had been paid with Summit miles, the refund is made in miles to the member's Summit membership, not in cash.
